title: Finite group schemes as fundamental group schemes of smooth projective varieties
summary: In this paper we study the problem of realizing finite group schemes as fundamental group schemes of smooth projective varieties. We establish Bertini-type results and prove the triviality of fundamental group schemes of mildly singular complete intersections in projective space.
